## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vipākattika* ("The Triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'") is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Nyanatiloka 1938]. It constitutes one of the twenty-two primary triad divisions (*tika*) in the *Tika-Paṭṭhāna*, systematically investigating phenomena categorized under karmic resultants, states productive of resultant, and states that are neither [Nyanatiloka 1938]. Like other triads in the collection, its analysis proceeds through standardized structural chapters (*vāra*), such as the chapter on investigations (*pañha-vāra*), being conjoined (*saṃsaṭṭha-vāra*), and being associated (*sampayutta-vāra*) [Nyanatiloka 1938].
